scenario: LCON.2.7.1 float determinism — multiplication. `0.1 * 0.1` is the IEEE 754 double 0.010000000000000002, not 0.01. The guard `(t.x * t.x) == 0.010000000000000002` fires only on an exact bit match; fact_count 2 confirms.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Float key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x * t.x) == 0.010000000000000002
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
